title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Krishan Lal and Dr Saroop jee acted upon their dreams in which they saw Prophet Muhammad Sallallaho alehe wa aaleyhi wa sallam. They left Hinduism and became Muslim despite all odds they had to face. Noor ud in Zangi, Tariq bin Ziaad had acted on what Prophet Muhammad Sallallaho alehe wa aaleyhi wa sallam said to them in their dreams.See what would have been the result if they had not acted upon? There are numerous examples which can be cited in this regards yet some Ulema preach inaction on the sayings of Prophet Muhammad Sallallah alihe wa aaleyhi wa sallam ? Are those Ulema right? Please Qoute Quraan and Hadith Only. 1636 views Q. Dream 1456 views Q. A couple of days ago, I dreamed that I am on the edge of a small river. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, My brother in law lives in Canada. I saw a dream last night (I don?t know the time). I saw that my husband and my mother in law have come to our home. It is not our real home but in the dream it is our home. They ring the bell. I open the door. They come inside. I did not see my husbands face but his shirt and pant is recognized by me. I follow him. When he turns around, I see that he is not my husband but my brother in law. His one hand and half face has some major skin disease. It looked terrible and scary. Then everyone starts discussing that he got this disease in Canada and because the treatment is very expensive in Canada, he has come here to treat himself. Please interpret this dream for me. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36556 Country: India Title: Currently I am in Jeddah, KSA. I seen this dream after praying Fajr salah and slept for 20 minutes. In dream I see I reached India Question: Currently I am in Jeddah, KSA. I seen this dream after praying Fajr salah and slept for 20 minutes. In dream I see I reached India, the day was Friday in my watch time was 11.00 am which was not changed so actual time in India will be 1:30 pm. I started from home for Jumuah prayer after doing wudhu. When I reached to mosque (exactly same mosque where I was praying Jumuah in India). I see first my wudhu breaks due to urine passing, again I done wudhu. Then second time I see my hand is dry so I made again wudhu. Lastly when I was cleaning my legs, people start praying sunnah of Jumuah's. My eyes open due to alarm and I have to go for office. Answer ID: 36556 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 312/242/D=1433) The meaning of this dream is not obvious; hence you should not pay any attention to it. However, it may be notable that you should maintain taharah and wudhu and keep on reading these duas: اللهم اني اسئلك تمام الوضو وتمام الصلوة وتمام مغفرتك وتمام رضوانک Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
